1: 	Delivering Msg4 and RRC messages in different TBs is allowed and should be supported by all the UEs for the following procedures:
(1) RRC connection establishment;
(2) RRC connection resume;
(3) RRC connection re-establishment.
=>	Companies can double check this working assumption and if there are any concerns then they shall be raised on the RAN2 reflector before the end of the Thursday 18 April 2019. If no concerns are raised then this can be considered agreed, and if concerns are raised then the topic will be discussed again at RAN2#106.
R2-1903676	RRC release with suspend configuration and inter-RAT redirection	MediaTek Inc.	draftCR	Rel-15	38.331	15.5.0	F	NR_newRAT-Core
-	Ericsson think that it is clear in 38.331 that the UE moves to idle when it changes RAT.
-	Intel agree we have this requirement to go to idle. So it would be useless for the network to provide this configuration.
-	ZTE think this can be left to network implementation to avoid this.
-	Huawei think this can be left to network.
-	Qualcomm agree with the intent but nothing is broken as the UE will go to idle immediately. Samsung agree nothing is broken.
-	MediaTek thinks the current requirement for Idle is for IRAT cell reselection but it is not clear if redirection is also consider a reselection.
-	Samsung think that the network could do this and if the UE fails to find an IRAT cell then the UE will stay in inactive.
=>	Revised to make it clear that UE goes to idle for cell selection of an IRAT cell as well as for cell reselection of an IRAT cell. Coversheet and title make also need to be updated
=>	Revised in R2-1905370 (Offline discussion 22)
R2-1905370	RRC release with suspend configuration and inter-RAT redirection	MediaTek Inc.	draftCR	Rel-15	38.331	15.5.0	F	NR_newRAT-Core
=>	Agreed in principle
R2-1904545	Note on UE behavior upon T380 expiration	Qualcomm Incorporated	draftCR	Rel-15	38.331	15.5.0	NR_newRAT-Core
=>	Not agreed (already captured in the latest spec by rapporteur CR from last meeting)
R2-1904635	Correction to RRCResumeRequest definition (38.331)	Ericsson	draftCR	Rel-15	38.331	15.5.0	F	NR_newRAT-Core
-	Samsung wonder if we have to specify the size in bits
-	Huawei think the current spec is correct.
=>	Remove the bit sizes from the 2 messages in the rapporteur CR.
